meta.title: Vendor Discovery and EOI: refused for a user without the Category Manager role
gaps: Sign in as the non-Category Manager user and verify whether Vendor Discovery and EOI is refused or absent.
Use Vendor Discovery and EOI to discover vendors by region and commodity and collect expressions of interest.
Repeat the same action as a Category Manager and compare availability in the same tenant.
Verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan and record any deliberate RBAC configuration granting access to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Category Manager user and as a Category Manager in the same Growth tenant, test Vendor Discovery and EOI for regional and commodity vendor discovery and expressions of interest, and report whether access is refused or available and any deliberate RBAC configuration
